# Process {.phase-process}

Process is the second block of the PFTC toolbox.
It has five steps.

- **Digitize.** Enter the field and lab sheets. The trait wheel has the [data entry](5_trait_collection.qmd#data-entry) notes.
- **Import.** Read the tables into R.
- **Clean.** Find and correct errors.
- **Process.** Reshape the data for analysis.
- **Analyse.** Fit the models and draw the figures.

Import and cleaning are in [Data curation](9_data_curation.qmd).
The two analysis tutorials are [Plant community composition data](10_community.qmd) and [Plant functional trait data](12_traits.qmd).

R, statistics, and GitHub are taught in the [BioSTATS books](https://biostats-r.github.io/biostats/index.html).
The short guide in this book is [Reproducible workflows, version control](8_reproducible.qmd).
